name: locus
description: A minimal, local-first annotation layer for academic reading.

scripts.build:store: NODE_ENV=production LOCUS_STORE_BUILD=1 wxt build -b chrome --mode production
scripts.build:store:edge: NODE_ENV=production LOCUS_STORE_BUILD=1 wxt build -b edge --mode production
scripts.zip:store: NODE_ENV=production LOCUS_STORE_BUILD=1 wxt zip -b chrome --mode production && node scripts/verify-store-build.mjs chrome
scripts.zip:store:edge: NODE_ENV=production LOCUS_STORE_BUILD=1 wxt zip -b edge --mode production && node scripts/verify-store-build.mjs edge
